newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm on strength in US markets.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm on strength in US markets.

text.p: NWE oil products were pushed up on Thursday on the back of buoyant U.S. markets, traders said.
Gas oil firmed 50 cents to $171.50 a tonne. Premiums were mixed, with a prompt heating oil barge done lower at August IPE +$0.50. Cargo differentials were notionally stable.
Gasoline was $2-3 a tonne firmer as the stronger U.S. combined with tight local supplies to push numbers higher.
Fuel oil firmed notionally, partly on crude's firmness, but markets were deadly quiet. High sulphur barges were quoted at $91-$92.50 but nothing was seen done.
